services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Full cycle — from concept to dismantling
services.label: What we do

items.title: Design & 3D Visualization
items.short: Unique stand concepts with detailed 3D renders tailored to your brand
items.full: Our designers develop a stand concept considering your brand, participation goals, and budget. You receive full 3D visualizations and blueprints before production begins — no surprises at the exhibition.

items.title: Stand Production
items.short: We manufacture stands of any complexity at our own facility
items.full: Our 2000 m² production facility allows us to build stands from small modular structures to large two-story pavilions. We use European materials and modern equipment.

items.title: Installation & Dismantling
items.short: Professional installation teams at every venue
items.full: Our installation teams work within the strict time constraints of exhibitions. We take full responsibility for assembly and dismantling — you simply approve the finished result.

items.title: Branding & Navigation
items.short: Printing, banners, navigation elements and brand environments
items.full: We develop and produce all branding elements: large-format printing, roll-ups, lightboxes, navigation stands, branded furniture and accessories — all in a unified style.

items.title: Logistics & Storage
items.short: Delivery of structures throughout Central Asia and abroad
items.full: We organize delivery of the stand to the exhibition venue anywhere in Uzbekistan and abroad. We provide storage services for structures between exhibitions.

items.title: On-Site Support
items.short: Technical staff and project manager throughout the exhibition
items.full: A technical specialist is present at the stand throughout the entire exhibition. The project manager coordinates all matters so you can focus on negotiations.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.subtitle: Over 5000 completed projects across Central Asia

process.title: How We Work
process.subtitle: From the first call to the last bolt — a transparent process
process.label: Our process

steps.title: Brief
steps.desc: We discuss participation goals, stand area, budget and design preferences. We get to know your brand and competitors.

steps.title: 3D Concept
steps.desc: Designers create 2–3 concept options with detailed 3D visualizations and floor plans.

steps.title: Approval
steps.desc: We make revisions, approve the final design and budget. We sign the contract and begin production.

steps.title: Production
steps.desc: We manufacture all structural elements at our own facility. Photo reports at each stage.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.desc: We package and deliver the stand to the exhibition venue on exactly agreed terms.

steps.title: Installation
steps.desc: Professional crew assembles the stand. Final check of all elements before the exhibition opens.

steps.title: Dismantling
steps.desc: After the exhibition ends, we disassemble and remove structures. We offer storage until the next event.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most popular questions about our work

items.q: How much does an exhibition stand cost?
items.a: The cost depends on area, construction complexity and materials used. A modular stand of 6 m² starts from $800. A custom stand of 18–36 m² — from $3,000. Two-story and exclusive structures are priced individually. We always offer several options to fit your budget.

Standard production time is 14–21 business days from design approval. For complex structures — up to 30 days. If necessary, we can organize accelerated production. We recommend contacting us 4–6 weeks before the exhibition.

Yes, we actively work in Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, and also travel to international exhibitions in Russia, UAE and Germany. We organize full logistics and have experience with customs clearance.

items.q: Can you help with design from scratch?
items.a: Absolutely! Our designers will develop a concept from scratch based on your brief and brand guidelines. We'll offer 2–3 concept options and guide you through the entire approval process to final sign-off.

We work with aluminum profile systems (Octanorm, Maxima), MDF, chipboard, acrylic, metal and glass. For finishing we use high-quality films, lacquers and paints. All materials are certified and meet exhibition venue requirements.

Full cycle includes: design and 3D visualization, manufacturing of all structural elements, branding and printing, delivery to the venue, installation and decoration, technical support during the exhibition, dismantling and removal of structures, storage at our warehouse.

items.q: How do we start working together?
items.a: Fill out the form on our website or call us. A manager will contact you within an hour, clarify the details of your project and prepare a preliminary commercial offer. First consultation and concept development are free.
